# Vendored libraries

- Splitting 1.1.0: npm package `splitting@1.1.0`, MIT license in `splitting-LICENSE.txt`.
- GSAP 3.9.1: existing site version from cdnjs; its copyright and license notice are retained at the top of `gsap-3.9.1.min.js`. The npm package identifies its license as the GreenSock standard license: https://greensock.com/standard-license.

These versions match the original site dependencies. The cells stylesheet is unused: the site only splits text.
